name: Frontend File Search and Secured Lite
author: haohunter

sections.description:
Frontend File Search and Secured Lite lets you expose a real-time file search interface on the front end of your WordPress site. Visitors can type a query and see matching media library items instantly via AJAX, without page reloads.

Upgrade to the Pro version for advanced filters, previews, bulk downloads, statistics, role-based access and more!

Buy PRO now → Upgrade to Frontend File Search and Secured Pro Today! →

Shortcode

[ffssrd_file_search]

Free Version Includes

  • Real-time AJAX search as you type
  • Configurable allowed image types (JPG, JPEG, PNG, GIF)
  • Fixed maximum of 5 results
  • Optional direct download links

  • One-time purchase—lifetime license, no recurring fees

sections.installation:
1. Upload the frontend-file-search-secured-lite folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Adjust Allowed File Types and Enable Download in Settings → File Search Lite.
  4. Insert the shortcode [ffssrd_file_search] into any post or page.
sections.faq:
Can I upgrade to the Pro version from Lite?

Yes! Purchase lifetime access to Pro here:
https://antigymclub.gumroad.com/l/FrontendFileSearchandSecuredpro

Can I limit search to a single file type?

Yes. Go to Settings → File Search and select only the extensions you wish to allow.

How do I prevent visitors from downloading certain files?

Disable the “Enable Download” option in Settings → File Search.

Does the plugin work without jQuery?

The Lite version uses jQuery for compatibility. The PRO version offer a vanilla-JS option.
